name: identity
sql: SELECT current_database() AS database,current_user AS role,current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only,to_regclass('meta_ads.unified_products')::text AS unified_products

name: source_bounds
sql: SELECT 'META' AS platform,coalesce(connection_id::text,'LEGACY_UNBOUND') AS scope,min(metric_date)::text AS from_date,max(metric_date)::text AS to_date,count(*)::text AS rows FROM meta_ads.meta_adset_daily_metrics WHERE is_current GROUP BY connection_id UNION ALL SELECT 'CAFE24',coalesce(connection_id::text,'LEGACY_UNBOUND'),min(order_date)::text,max(order_date)::text,count(*)::text FROM meta_ads.cafe24_order_lines WHERE is_current GROUP BY connection_id UNION ALL SELECT 'GOOGLE',connection_id::text,min(metric_date)::text,max(metric_date)::text,count(*)::text FROM meta_ads.google_campaign_daily_costs WHERE is_current GROUP BY connection_id

name: safe_schema
sql: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='meta_ads' AND table_name IN ('cafe24_order_lines','cafe24_product_rules','source_connections','product_cost_rules','google_performance_mappings','cafe24_coupon_rules','meta_adset_daily_metrics','exchange_rates','source_policies','source_coverage') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position
